parsed.summary: Mapping the build functionally onto the specification (the reference designators differ, so comparison was by role/net), every specified element is present and correct: the six 0-ohm servo-mode jumpers (pins 19/21 for one channel, 20/22 for the other, and the serial bridge to the MAX3485), the two 1k PWM series resistors, the 10k/5.1k bias into the BC857 auto-direction transistor driving DE/~RE, the 2k A pull-up plus 2.2k/2.2k B reference divider and 20k DE/~RE pull-down, the IRLML6402 battery switch with its 47k gate resistor, the SS54 (external input) and PMEG3030EP (servo rail) diode-isolated supplies, the four 100uF bulk caps and the 0.1uF 3V3 decoupling, and the MAX3485 UART-to-single-wire bus with TXD on pin 15/RXD on pin 16, 5V on pin 27 and BAT on pin 29. No shorted, open, mis-wired or mis-valued element was found relative to the intended design, so no anomaly is reported.
